Born and raised in Canada, I remember being about 10 years old the first time I visited our relatives in the USA. Driving down to California we stopped at a Supermarket I might guess Idaho somewhere. My 10-year-old brain almost imploded upon discovering the 'snack aisle'. I mean, for starters it seems a mile long. I don't remember Canadian stores even having entire shorter aisles dedicated to snacks alone. Usually a section or side. But in America WOW it was the entire long length and every shelf packed. Now forget the discovery of at least 20 new chocolate bars I'd never seen before but chips, cakes, lots of 'cake snacks'. Twinkies. Cakes with cream in them. Yes we had those but the USA had 100X more and better and bigger ones, sweeter, more varieties! Then something Americans seem to love called 'fruit pies'. It's these handheld little 'pies' with crust and sweet apple or cherry fillings! And none of this was expensive! It was less than Canadian money!

Canadians inherited a lot of Britains WW2 mentality. Nothing offended us more than American comedies with a 'food fight'. Even as a kid I knew that was morally wrong and so offensive. We didn't have that many fat people. Like the UK it was probably a shameful thing coming from rations and food shortages in the war.

But that's all changed. The image of the skinny Mexicans (you can see that in old comics, movies etc) but holy hell I don't think I've seen a Mexican that wasn't 30lbs overweight in the last decade.

Our cousin worked at a famous UK tourist site. They used to have a running joke about how you could spot those George Carlin families and know they were Americans from a mile away by the husbands beer belly and the wife's jumbo hips. Not anymore. A few years ago I was in the old neighbourhood and walking about marveling at how little anything had changed. I mean, I have pictures from 20 years ago I could side-by-side to today and they'd match. Same old pub. But yet one single thing was different and once you saw it - you can never stop noticing it: Everyone is 15% fatter. Scrawny Scallies. Now replaced by filled-out Chavs with slightly plump cheeks. Lots of plumpers. Where as before you might see he odd chubby gal - you now see a fully overweight 'American mom' as Carlin paints them.

Oh and Canada? Don't worry we developed and then exploded what might be the most hyper-fattening food/drink combos on Earth: The Tims 'double-double' and sugar-laden fat-soaked sweetbread we call 'doughnuts'. Its like weight gain scientists in Canada decided to show the USA whos the most advanced and we came up with that and we won!

And now the kicker: Here in China. I'm still ashamed trying to explain to rice farmers how in the West we 'jog' and then go to gyms because we are so fucking fat and rich we actually have to do fake work to burn off the calories. These are people trying to NOT run or walk far because they need to conserve calories. Grandmother 'lifts weights' because she has to carry 2 buckets from the river. Even just 5 or 6 years ago you really didn't see many plump Chinese in the wealthier cities. The odd businessman had a nice little Buddha belly - a sign of success. I saw a massive whale of a fat Chinese lady in Walmart. the hottest new business here in the city? Weight loss Clinics, diet centers, slim-down clubs. I just signed up about 40 kids and no less than 10 of the boys are just the fattest little rolly-polly doughboys and even more surprising I have about 5 big fat girls. a few of them can go in the morbidly overweight category which is fuck'n sad to see on a 10 year old girl (good job parents).

So move over USA - the fatasses of the world are not only catching up but getting fatter faster and bigger! American isn't #1 anymore when it comes to this.

Then again.. holy hell it still boggles my mind when I visit the USA that yes actually there are a LOT of really really huge fat people heh. I think the USA still has the 'quantity' of fatties locked up! Then again.. wow Mexico. Wow. Is there a Mexican woman over 18 who didn't put on 85lbs (almost entirely on hips) during pregnancy!?
